s.t: On Baltimora's ‘Tarzan Boy’, producer Maurizio Bassi sang lead and co-writer Naimy Hackett the backing vocals; frontman Jimmy McShane, the face on television, mimed.
s.q: Bassi e Hackett scrivevano, arrangiavano e cantavano tutto: lui la parte solista e lei i cori. … Occorreva un ragazzo immagine, qualcuno che cantasse in playback … McShane non era un cantante, muoveva la bocca e si agitava, eppure Baltimora era lui.

s.t: When Jack ‘Jungle Boy’ Perry began entering to Baltimora's hit on AEW Dark in January 2021, AEW owner Tony Khan tweeted he'd bought the rights: “Merry Christmas, Jack.”
s.src: Sportskeeda: Tony Khan buys the rights for Tarzan Boy as Jungle Boy's new AEW theme
s.q: Yes, I bought the rights to Tarzan Boy for @boy_myth_legend's entrance. Merry Christmas, Jack. #AEWDynamite #AEWDark

s.t: Baltimora's frontman Jimmy McShane told the Manchester Evening News in 1985 that ‘Tarzan Boy’ was “pure novelty”, insisting: “I'm a serious musician and singer… I'm not a novelty merchant!”
s.q: In a 1985 interview with Manchester Evening News, McShane said of the song and its success, "It has been a big surprise but I'm not complaining! It's pure novelty. … I'm a serious musician and singer. I sing all kinds of music – I'm not a novelty merchant!

s.t: It crossed into Bollywood: ‘Aaya Mausam Dosti Ka’, from the soundtrack of the 1989 film Maine Pyar Kiya, was heavily influenced by Baltimora's ‘Tarzan Boy’.
s.q: In 1989, the Hindi song "Aaya Mausam Dosti Ka", from the Bollywood soundtrack for the film Maine Pyar Kiya was heavily influenced by "Tarzan Boy".

s.t: Czech Extraliga team HC Sparta Praha has played the chorus of Baltimora's hit as its goal song at home games, every time it scores, since the 1986–87 season.
s.q: Czech Extraliga team HC Sparta Praha has used the chorus of the song regularly since the 1986–1987 season in its home arenas as their official goal song, played each time the team scores a goal.

f.t: Their frontman Jimmy McShane was working as a Red Cross nurse when he was offered the chance to be the project's face and body, and he dropped everything.
f.q: Il ballerino e cantante nordirlandese Jimmy McShane, che aveva già avuto esperienza come corista di Dee D. Jackson, in quel momento faceva l’infermiere alla Croce rossa, ma mollò tutto quando gli proposero di diventare il volto e il corpo di Baltimora.

f.t: Jimmy McShane picked their name blind: eyes shut, finger on a map of the United States, he hit Baltimore, then they swapped its last letter for an Italian ‘a’.
f.q: McShane and Bassi chose the name Baltimora when, one evening together, McShane took a map of the United States, closed his eyes and happened to place his finger on Baltimore. They changed the final letter to an 'a' to make the name more in keeping with the act's Italian roots.

f.t: Their follow-up hit ‘Woody Boogie’ used almost the same song structure as ‘Tarzan Boy’, swapping its Tarzan yell for keyboards imitating Woody Woodpecker's call.
f.q: Tarzan boy e Woody boogie avevano in comune, oltre alla struttura quasi identica della canzone, un’estetica da cartone animato: in Tarzan boy c’era l’urlo di Tarzan e in Woody boogie le tastiere imitavano l’inconfondibile verso del picchio Woody Woodpecker.

f.t: Their first album's title, Living in the Background, is said to have been producer Maurizio Bassi's ironic reference to himself.
f.q: Tarzan Boy ist eine Single aus dem ersten Baltimora -Album "Living In The Background" (womit Bassi ironischerweise sich selbst gemeint haben soll)

f.t: In 2021 a 20-year-old from Ancona won Italy's X Factor under the stage name Baltimora, prompting Internazionale journalist Daniele Cassandro to point out that the name was already taken.
f.q: L’edizione di X Factor quest’anno è stata vinta da un ventenne anconetano che si è presentato con il nome d’arte di Baltimora. … Qualcuno a X Factor però poteva dirgli che Baltimora era un nome d’arte già preso.

nf.t: Its frontman was a Red Cross nurse who mimed; the producer did the singing.
nf.q: Bassi e Hackett scrivevano, arrangiavano e cantavano tutto: lui la parte solista e lei i cori. … Jimmy McShane, … in quel momento faceva l’infermiere alla Croce rossa, ma mollò tutto quando gli proposero di diventare il volto e il corpo di Baltimora.
